title: Prayer of St. Ignatius (Dearest Lord, Teach Me to Be Generous)
text:
Dearest Lord, teach me to be generous;
Teach me to serve thee as thou deservest;
To give and not to count the cost,
To fight and not to seek for rest,
To labour and not to seek reward,
Save that of knowing that I do thy will.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
